src/daemon/db/session-ledger.ts.rationale: S004: existing bounded in-memory HMAC ledger admits remove and publishes the unchanged safe removed/not-applicable outcome in the same synchronous turn as overlay commit. src/daemon/db/session-management.ts.rationale: S004: strict bounded exact decoders plus pure safe projection compose the existing trusted binding, overlay and ledger.
